cards.title: Should we move closer to family before school?
cards.body: A parent asks whether relocating near family is worth it before their daughter starts school. The advice weighs the benefits of family support against the costs of uprooting and leaving new friendships behind.

cards.title: Adult son moves back home after graduation
cards.body: A mother reflects on her graduate son returning to the family nest due to economic pressures. She humorously navigates the transition from empty nester back to active parenting duties.

cards.title: Is it OK to leave your family for adventure?
cards.body: A parent questions whether it's acceptable to abandon family responsibilities—including small children—to pursue wilderness adventures. The article explores the ethics of choosing personal ambitions over parenting duties.

cards.title: Listen when your children ask for help
cards.body: Rather than solving children's problems immediately, parents should let them struggle and develop independence. Listening skills help children learn resilience and problem-solving abilities.

cards.title: Play, risk, and childhood freedom
cards.body: Modern parenting has shifted from free-ranging play to constant parental supervision. The article examines how hovering affects children's development and risk assessment abilities.

cards.title: Stopping sexual violence starts in childhood
cards.body: Early childhood education and parenting practices are crucial to preventing sexual violence. The article explores how parents can teach children about boundaries and consent.

cards.title: Teen therapy-speak: A parent's guide
cards.body: Mental health terminology from therapy is increasingly entering teens' everyday language. Parents can understand and support their children better by learning what these terms mean.

cards.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued in South Carolina
cards.body: An 11-month-old baby was found alive after being buried in a crate near his father's home. The child is being cared for in hospital following the rescue.

cards.title: Australian teen missing in bush rescued alive
cards.body: A 17-year-old was found alive after six days missing in the Australian bush. His mother joked he is now grounded for life following the frightening ordeal.
